_meta.tierC_source: Manual — operator updated on NYSDOH outbreak declaration

covid-19.note: Wastewater signal elevated and rising across several NYS regions, particularly downstate. Dominant variant is JN.1 descendants.

influenza.note: Off-season. Flu activity is low. The 2025-26 season has ended. Updated vaccine available in late summer.

rsv.note: Off-season. RSV activity is low. Wastewater signal at baseline. Season typically begins in October.

norovirus.note: Wastewater signal at seasonal baseline. No current outbreaks reported. Norovirus peaks November through April.

west-nile-virus.note: Mosquito season underway. First WNV-positive mosquito pools detected in Nassau and Suffolk counties. Human case season peaks August-September.

eastern-equine-encephalitis.note: No EEE activity detected in NYS yet this season. NYSDOH monitoring mosquito pools statewide.

lyme-disease.note: Peak tick season. Case reports running ahead of last year in the Hudson Valley, Long Island, and Capital Region.

anaplasmosis.note: Tick activity at peak. 2024 saw 2,025 statewide cases. Hudson Valley and Long Island highest burden.

babesiosis.note: 748 cases statewide in 2024. Suffolk County consistently highest burden. Peak season June-August.

ehrlichiosis.note: 133 cases statewide in 2024. Rare but present during tick season.

rocky-mountain-spotted-fever.note: 12 cases statewide in 2024. Rare in NYS; most cases travel-associated.

west-nile-fever.note: 32 cases statewide in 2024. Related to West Nile Virus; milder presentation.

malaria.note: 320 cases statewide in 2024, predominantly travel-associated. No local transmission.

dengue-fever.note: 352 cases statewide in 2024, all travel-associated. No local mosquito transmission in NYS.

campylobacteriosis.note: 7,622 cases statewide in 2024, consistent with historical baseline. Most cases in summer months.

salmonellosis.note: 3,974 cases statewide in 2024. No current cluster outbreaks reported.

shigellosis.note: 2,938 cases statewide in 2024. Slightly elevated vs prior years; monitoring ongoing.

e-coli-stec.note: 1,775 cases statewide in 2024. No current outbreak clusters. Summer peak expected.

cryptosporidiosis.note: 924 cases statewide in 2024. Peaks in summer with recreational water season.

giardiasis.note: 2,493 cases statewide in 2024. Year-round endemic disease.

listeriosis.note: 127 cases statewide in 2024. No current multistate outbreak linked to NYS.

cyclosporiasis.note: 691 cases statewide in 2024. Peaks in summer; often linked to imported produce.

vibriosis.note: 408 cases statewide in 2024. Risk from raw shellfish and warm coastal water.

hemolytic-uremic-syndrome.note: 8 cases statewide in 2024. Rare complication of STEC E. coli.

hepatitis-a.note: 111 cases statewide in 2024. No current cluster outbreaks.

chlamydia.note: 102,175 cases statewide in 2024. Most common reportable STI in NYS. Testing recommended for all sexually active adults under 25.

gonorrhea.note: 45,218 cases statewide in 2024. Rising trend in recent years. Increasing antibiotic resistance is a public health concern.

syphilis-early.note: 5,984 cases statewide in 2024. Continued rising trend. Congenital syphilis is a growing concern.

mpox.note: Transmission in NYS is low following the 2022 outbreak. JYNNEOS vaccine remains available for high-risk individuals.

tuberculosis.note: 1,089 cases statewide in 2024. NYS has among the highest TB rates in the US, concentrated in urban counties.

legionellosis.note: 799 cases statewide in 2024. Peaks in summer. Major outbreak risk in cooling towers and hot water systems.

pertussis.note: 2,875 cases statewide in 2024, above recent year averages. National uptick being monitored.

mumps.note: 35 cases statewide in 2024. Sporadic cases in unvaccinated clusters.

varicella.note: 381 cases statewide in 2024. Predominantly in unvaccinated individuals.

meningococcal.note: 51 cases statewide in 2024. Rare; vaccine recommended for adolescents and college students.

meningitis-aseptic.note: 179 cases statewide in 2024 (NYS excl NYC). Peaks in summer.

acute-flaccid-myelitis.note: 4 cases statewide in 2024 (NYS excl NYC). Rare neurological condition.

q-fever.note: 5 cases statewide in 2024. Rare; associated with livestock contact.

brucellosis.note: 3 cases statewide in 2024. Rare; associated with unpasteurized dairy or animal contact.

candida-auris.note: 147 cases statewide in 2024 (NYS excl NYC). Drug-resistant fungal infection; primarily healthcare settings.

blastomycosis.note: 6 cases statewide in 2024. Rare fungal infection; associated with soil/water exposure.

visa-staph.note: 4 cases statewide in 2024 (NYS excl NYC). Drug-resistant staph; healthcare setting risk.

measles.note: Active outbreak in Rockland County. 12 confirmed cases as of June 6, 2026. All cases in unvaccinated individuals. NYSDOH contact tracing ongoing.

botulism.note: 5 cases statewide in 2024. No current outbreak.

diphtheria.note: 0 cases expected. No cases reported in NYS in 2024.
